definitions: Units of weight, each equal to 1/16 of an ounce (avoirdupois) or 1/8 of an ounce (apothecaries').
Small quantities of alcoholic drink, especially whiskey.
Units of liquid measure, each equal to 1/8 of a fluid ounce.
examples: He added two drams of the spice.
They shared a few drams by the fire.
The recipe called for drams of extract.
